Build rule that adds fd_sock_tile to fd_disco when FD_HAS_ALLOCA is set.

# Purpose
This makefile fragment adds `fd_disco` to the `fd_sock_tile` object list only when `FD_HAS_ALLOCA` is defined. The `ifdef` and `endif` directives control conditional build inclusion for code that depends on `alloca` support.
